senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="L00003">same</cite> <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 2:5">Targ. Gen. II, 5</cite>; a. v. fr.—
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 10b:19">Pes. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>מקמיה … אין בתר … לא</he> before the time when it is forbidden, yes (he must search after leavened bread); after the time, no (he must not search).
<cite ref="Pesachim 10b:19">Ib.</cite> <he>לא שנא</he> there is no difference; a. v. fr.
